# Realm Resource Identifier

## Contract
The realm-relative path of one resource inside a realm: `Invoice/inv-2026-018`
(an instance), `matrix-tracker.gts` (a module), `Spec/table.json` (a source
file). Realm identifier + resource identifier = absolute URL.

Invariants:
- Instances are extensionless; source files carry their extension; the same
  stem addresses both views of one card.
- Directory segments are meaningful for listing/permissions but not for
  type — a card's type comes from `meta.adoptsFrom`, never its folder.

## Captured example
`MatrixConcept/l03-cv-table` and `MatrixConcept/l03-cv-table.json` in this
realm — instance and source views of one resource.

## Source
Addressing rules in `runtime-common`; realm-facing field:
`https://cardstack.com/base/realm`.
